emails.subject: URGENT FOLLOW-UP: Overdue Critical Queries - Study IP-201, Site 101
emails.body:
Hi Mark,

I hope you are having a good week.

I am following up on the list of critical data queries for Study IP-201 that were sent two weeks ago. As of this morning, the attached list of queries are now over 14 days past due.

Resolving these is a high priority as we are approaching the database lock for the Part A (healthy volunteer) cohort analysis, scheduled for November 10th. All critical queries must be addressed before we can proceed.

I understand you have many competing priorities. To help expedite this, I would be happy to schedule a 30-minute call to walk through the outstanding items together and resolve them in real-time. Please let me know what your availability looks like for tomorrow or early next week.

Thank you for your urgent attention to this matter.

Best regards,

Jane Doe
Clinical Research Associate
Innovate Pharma
jane.doe@innovatepharma.com
(123) 456-7890

emails.subject: Re: URGENT FOLLOW-UP: Overdue Critical Queries - Study IP-201, Site 101
emails.body:
Hi Jane,

Thank you for the follow-up and my apologies for the delay on these. We've had some unexpected staff shortages this month which has put us behind.

A call would be very helpful. I am available tomorrow at 11:00 AM EST or 2:00 PM EST. Please let me know which time works best for you.

I will review the list in the meantime.

Thanks,

Mark Smith
Data Manager
Summit Clinical Trials

emails.subject: Re: URGENT FOLLOW-UP: Overdue Critical Queries - Study IP-201, Site 101
emails.body:
Hi Mark,

Thanks for the quick reply. I completely understand.

Tomorrow at 11:00 AM EST works perfectly for me. I will send a calendar invitation with a conference link shortly.

Talk to you then.

Best,

Jane

Clinical Research Associate
